title: Chain Business + General Location Modifier
description: Rules for evaluating map results when the user queries a chain business with a general location modifier such as a city, neighborhood, or directional area (e.g., 'Starbucks in Seattle', 'McDonald's downtown', 'KFC near Midtown').

decision_logic.condition: Result is NOT the queried chain
decision_logic.notes: Must be the correct chain brand

decision_logic.condition: Result IS the queried chain AND is located in the exact specified area
decision_logic.notes: Chain in the correct general area — high relevance. Multiple locations in the area also rate Excellent.

decision_logic.condition: Result IS the queried chain but is in an adjacent neighborhood or just outside the specified area
decision_logic.notes: Close to specified area but not exact — still useful

decision_logic.condition: Result IS the queried chain but is in a different part of the city (not the specified area)
decision_logic.notes: Same city but wrong area — marginally relevant

decision_logic.condition: Result IS the queried chain but is in a completely different city or area
decision_logic.notes: Wrong city entirely — not relevant to the modifier

exceptions: If the general modifier is ambiguous (e.g., 'downtown' could apply to multiple cities), use judgment
For directional modifiers (north, south), the result should be in that general direction from city center
If there are no locations of the chain in the specified area, the nearest one may rate Good

conditions: Result is on Broadway in Capitol Hill area
calibration_examples.reasoning: Starbucks located directly in Capitol Hill — step 2 applies

conditions: N Michigan Ave is downtown Chicago
calibration_examples.reasoning: McDonald's in downtown Chicago matches the general modifier — step 2

conditions: Upper East Side is adjacent to midtown area
calibration_examples.reasoning: Adjacent to specified area — step 3 applies

conditions: Queens is a different borough, not Brooklyn
calibration_examples.reasoning: Different borough but same metro area — step 4 applies
